setlist.title: He Was A Friend Of Mine

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Similar in spirit to the February 27 Live Dead version, though slightly less perfect; Considered a strong performance, consistent with the reviewer's view of no bad 1969 versions [3][7]
- **Yellow Dog Story Part 1** (1 review): Identified as the first recorded rendition of the Dog joke in that era [13]
- **He Was A Friend Of Mine** (1 review): Described as a very good version of this specific song [12]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): Described as hot as high heaven, prompting the reviewer to raise their rating [13]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): Reviewer praises the barbershop-style 'shine on me' section within this song [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Yellow Dog Story Part 1**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **Yellow Dog Story Part 2**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]

## The recordings

- **gd69-04-12.sbd.cotsman.14914.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 13 songs; 106 min; rated 3.93/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: Analog recording features noticeable hiss, which the reviewer finds charming and authentic; Analog recording includes hiss and pops, possibly from inadequate grounding or light bleed [2][10]

## Around the show

- Jerry Garcia appeared agitated by a crowd that was not dancing during the performance [2]
- Rare poster depicts a fan holding an ES335 knock-off with headphones attached [4]
- Approximately ten minutes are missing from the first set, including the entire Other One [1]
- Described as not as strong or well played as the following night's performance [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-04-12.sbd.cotsman.14914.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by J. Cotsman; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Sound Forge software was used for normalization and pitch correction on the transfer [1]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.bahrgallery.com: [Grateful Dead, SDS Ball, Utah, 1969 - Band - Items - Bahr Gallery](https://www.bahrgallery.com/band-items/grateful-dead-sds-ball-utah-1969) [15]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1969-04-12 Grateful Dead Poster - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1969-04-12-grateful-dead-poster/) [16]
